summary: Both occurrences are already quoted at LB 124: the Infinitiv u waxt du neḏ̣oyo under sense 1 and Infectum-wa mnaḏ̣ewa under sense 2. Talay 1/124 supplies the same passage, so no duplicate example is added.

The finite verb describes the muezzin's recurrent call from the minaret, not ritual washing. The nominal names prayer or the prayer event in a time expression; its exact prayer/call boundary is not decided by this token.

Read-only lookups: wḏ̣y has ritual washing with mwaḏ̣e/mətwaḏ̣e marked uncertain; ndy has general calling with mnadele/mnade. These distinct source entries support keeping the current nḏ̣y filing for this exact quotation, but do not establish the historical derivation.
Existing senses, etymological alternatives, spelling and cross-reference to wḏ̣y remain unchanged.

Can a speaker or source check distinguish the prayer/call event nominal neḏ̣oyo from ritual washing and establish its relationship to ndy? This corpus repeats one existing passage and cannot settle etymology.
